stem: Which statement describes the time period of the 1950s in the United States?

options.label: A
options.text: Increase in military enlistment and women working outside the home

options.label: B
options.text: Growth of economic prosperity and support for anti-communist policies

options.label: C
options.text: Rise of environmental conservation and improvements in working conditions

options.label: D
options.text: Expansion of work programs and creation of retirement benefits
